angola-2018.notes: Source 1 (ANGOP article, angop.ao) belongs to angola-2020: it reports the 5th AOCPC of 29-30 December 2020 (17 teams from eight institutions, 13 problems; ISPTEC first with 9, ISUTIC 8, UAN 4). It is a news report, not the contest's website.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw only copies of the ANGOP homepage from 2018; our present copy is the article itself, which reports the December 2020 contest.
sources.evidence: ANGOP news article of Monday 4 January 2021, 'Three Angolan representatives at African Programming contest', reports the 5th Angolan University Programming Contest (AOCPC) held on 29 and 30 December 2020 and never mentions 2018.
